page.layout: One text block of two paragraphs, below two coin engravings at the top. No marginal notes. Running head at the top with the page number to its left.

main_text.p: NICEPHORVS Patricius, relegata Irene, Constantinopolitanum imperiũ invadit anno mundi 4764. à Christo nato 802. Hic fœdus cum Carolo magno icit. Nemo maiore opinione hominum ad imperium venit, dum singulos aut muliebris impotentiæ, aut flagitiosi principis tædet: nemo tamen avarius aut crudelius administravit: quorũ scelerum mox pœnas meritas luit. A Bulgaris enim paulò ante à se victis, improviso noctis assultu oppressus, ipse cum toto exercitu ad internecionem cæditur. Stauracius filius faucius evadit, qui cum patre imperarat, & post patrem Imperator ab amicis salutatus, non multò post à Michaële Curoplate, qui sororem eius in vxorem duxerat, imperio deturbatur, & monasterio includitur. Vide Blon. lib.2. Egn. lib. 2. Stauracius in hac Imperatorum serie minimè à nobis inseritur, quòd paucis diebus post Nicephorum patrem imperitarit.

MICHAEL Curoplates, Rangabe cognomento, imperarat, qua dixi via, Constantinopoli anno mundi 4773. à Christo nato 811. hic melior pacis artibus & pietate, quàm bellicis rebus administrandis, ad unam adversam cum Bulgaris pugnam, ita deiecit animũ, ut accepto nuntio de Leonis imperio, qui post eum Constantinopoli imperat, monasterio sese abdiderit: habenas imperij facilè relinquens post annum alterum imperij. Hic quemadmodum Nicephorus, legaris ad Carolum magnum missis pacem fecit, hac conditione ut Veneti suis legibus ac iure viverent: immunitate his servata, quam ad eam diem retinuerant. Egn.lib.2.

page.notes: Two engravings of coins at the top of the page, not text. Left: a double portrait with the legend "D N NICEFORVS IMP" and "TAVRI TIVS AVG" (the second legend reads in reverse at the bottom), the obverse of Nicephorus and Stauracius. Right: a portrait with the legend "D N MICHAEL AVG", with a small ornament below the bust. Printed text is not reproduced in the engraving legends above; they are part of the image. Doubtful: the regnal year figure at the end of the Michael paragraph is printed as "4773" with a worn final digit, read as 3. No other doubtful readings.
